item.title: Crookston Park Board to meet Monday, February 9
item.description: The Crookston Park Board will meet on Monday, February 9 at 4:30 p.m. at the City Hall Conference room. The agenda includes discussing board members, the community survey, the feasibility study, and the Ray Ecklund grant.
